description: This file defines an Android activity called UnicodeChart that displays a chart of Unicode characters. It includes an inner class SampleView that handles rendering the chart and user input for navigation.

classes.name: UnicodeChart
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a chart of Unicode characters, allowing navigation with arrow keys.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View inside UnicodeChart that renders the Unicode character chart and handles user input for navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets window features, and attaches the custom view.

methods.name: drawChart
methods.description: Draws the Unicode characters starting from a base value onto the canvas.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides View's method to draw background and the character chart.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles arrow key presses to change the Unicode base and refresh the display.

methods.name: computeX
methods.description: Calculates the X position for a character based on its index.

methods.name: computeY
methods.description: Calculates the Y position for a character based on its index.
